supabase.description: The Supabase CLI, pinned by deno.lock: deno task supabase <command>

start.description: Start the local stack, then follow the Edge Function's logs in the foreground
start.command: deno task supabase start && docker logs --follow supabase_edge_runtime_cero-typescript

serve.description: Serve the Edge Function with hot reload (the stack must be running)

test.description: The Hono app's own tests, over the in-memory repositories

check.description: Type-check, lint and format-check the function
check.command: deno check --config supabase/functions/api/deno.json supabase/functions/api && deno lint && deno fmt --check

gen:types.description: Regenerate the adapter's row types from the local database, after a migration
gen:types.command: deno task supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > ../database/typescript-supabase/src/database.types.ts && deno fmt ../database/typescript-supabase/src/database.types.ts
